g.text: Contours: eastward stress′ at ±0.01, ±0.03, ±0.05 N m⁻²; solid + / dashed −
1982–2022 same-month linear expectation. Boxes: central (dashed), east (solid), 10°S–5°N.
May–June is common to all events; July and the full chronology remain in supporting figures.
This is spatial correspondence, not proof of the subsequent discharge mechanism.
